name: Choice Fatigue
description: Choice Fatigue is a self-hosted media discovery app with account-scoped recommendation learning, saved lists, and optional Adult discovery.

notes.text: The app is available over HTTP at the LXC IPv4 address on port 4173 for trusted local-network access. Before exposing it remotely, put it behind a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy and update BETTER_AUTH_URL in /opt/choice-fatigue/.env to the browser-facing URL, then restart choice-fatigue.service.
The first account becomes the administrator. Create a database and deployment-secret backup before upgrades or restores.
